test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 31 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having six different words - Life, Eat, Enjoy, Sleep Love and Care. Find the word on the face opposite the face showing 'Life'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa2b79bec52d38f822677bc92208ced9d0bc53be7cfc5929b79ca66646415da0.png]
solution:
From the given two dices,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41333313e1db5b15c600aaf4bac6287833759df1346bb95109d4e383c7adac63.png] 

→ Enjoy and eat are common surface in both Dice, therefore, 'Sleepy' is the opposite surface of 'Life'.

Here, 'Sleep' is opposite to the face containing 'Life'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Sleep".
